Q005.task: Implement checkpoint.load(path): return a JSON object only when status is exactly "ready" and resume is a nonempty string. Missing, malformed or invalid files return {"status":"blocked","resume":None}. Never modify or delete the input file. Only checkpoint.py may change; use Python -B.
Q005.verify:
import tempfile, json
from checkpoint import load
blocked = {"status": "blocked", "resume": None}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    path = Path(temp) / "checkpoint.json"
    assert load(path) == blocked
    for content in ["{", "[]", "null", '{"status":"ready","resume":""}']:
        path.write_text(content)
        assert load(path) == blocked
        assert path.read_text() == content
    good = {"status": "ready", "resume": "step-2"}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(good))
    assert load(path) == good
